overall_reason: A sage ground #e2ede7, a warm window body #f5f5f3, a slate-blue primary #344f61 and a muted green check form a quiet palette with clear action and success roles, but the text greys spread over five levels in two temperatures.

score.reason: T-PALETTE-ROLES finds five text levels and T-NEUTRALS finds sage, cool and warm neutrals together; T-ACCENT-DOSAGE passes with the slate held to 'Export package'.

findings.title: Text greys are a fixed set
findings.evidence: Leaving out the page caption, the text levels are #262628, #35414a (4), #7a8982 (2), #84909a (2) and #9aa39d. #7a8982 (sage) and #84909a (cool) sit at nearly the same lightness and do the same job ('Campaign-assets.zip', '24 assets selected').
findings.before: Five text greys, two of them near-duplicates in different hues.
findings.after: Three text levels (ink, secondary, tertiary) in one hue.
findings.why: Near-duplicate greys show the scale was not fixed.

findings.title: Neutrals hold one temperature
findings.evidence: The neutral temperature table counts 6 cool, 5 other (sage) and 3 untinted neutrals, and the window body is warm #f5f5f3.
findings.before: Sage, cool slate and warm off-white neutrals in one scene.
findings.after: One neutral temperature derived from the sage ground.
findings.why: Mixed temperatures make the neutrals look assembled.

findings.title: Depth comes from lightness and one shadow
findings.evidence: The palette table lists 2 shadow recipes: rgba(24,52,59,0.22) 0 16px on the window and rgba(22,60,43,0.22) 0 12px on the popover.
findings.after: One shadow recipe for both floating surfaces.
findings.why: Two recipes for the same job blur the depth system.

strengths: The slate #344f61 is used once, on the primary action.
Green is held to the 'Saved to downloads' check and the download icon tile.
not_investigated: T-DARK-MODE: the page renders light; the stylesheet has a dark class theme that the capture did not render, so dark mode is not verified
brand authority: the run has no 00-contract.md, so no brand colours were available for T-COLOUR-SOURCE; sources were traced from the composition itself
contrast and focus: owned by the sweep (A11-001, A11-003) and not restated here
The caption above the scene (#666666) is the capture's framing and was left out of the text levels
